title: When the Sigil Turns
premise: Ines Ravensworth has spent six years tasting poison for the crown, her body hardened by doses that would kill anyone else — and hiding the truth that her immunity is no accident but a rare gift the realm once covenanted to protect. When Queen Maren declares all gifted folk traitors and unleashes the Sigil Hunt, Ines flees into the Thornfell mountains she knows better than any soldier, carrying a smuggler's map that leads to the shattered borderstone binding the human and fae realms. Hunted by her former mentor Captain Aldric Vane and shadowed by a fugitive hedge-witch named Tam, Ines discovers the covenant broke because the last royal taster betrayed it — and that her own bloodline was chosen for this reckoning. At the winter solstice eclipse, Ines must choose between exposing the queen's lie (which will save the gifted but shatter the throne) or sealing herself into the borderstone as its living anchor; she finds a third path, reforging the covenant with her own freely given oath, at the cost of her place in the court she served.
about_author: Vesper Zhou is the pen name of a former line cook who claims the best plot ideas arrive during service rushes. They write fantasy about people whose ordinary jobs collide with impossible magic, from a cabin somewhere with unreliable internet.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: Ines detects nightshade in the queen's stew and saves the court, earning praise she doesn't want. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: quiet dread — her detection worked too fast, too precisely, and Captain Vane noticed. Establishes her double life: loyal servant by day, keeper of a dangerous secret by night.

chapters.title: Proclamation of Ash
chapters.summary: The queen declares the Sigil Hunt: all gifted must register or die. POV: Ines, with an interlude from Vane's ledger. Emotional beat: betrayal — the crown she tasted for now hunts what she is. Ines burns her mother's letters but keeps one page showing the old covenant's seal.

chapters.title: Thornfell Roads
chapters.summary: Ines flees north through smugglers' passes, using routes only food caravans know. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: grief and freedom tangled together as she abandons rank, wages, and identity. She rescues Tam, a hedge-witch cornered by hunters, out of instinct she can't explain.

chapters.title: What the Witch Knew
chapters.summary: Tam reveals the borderstone in the high pass is failing, and that tasters' bloodlines were its original wardens. POV: Tam. Emotional beat: reluctant trust — Tam tests Ines's loyalty with a truth-spell and gets more honesty than expected. They form an uneasy pact to reach the stone before solstice.

chapters.title: Vane's Hounds
chapters.summary: Captain Vane tracks them through the foothills, torn between duty and his history with Ines's family. POV: Vane. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. conscience — he finds evidence the queen manufactured the 'gifted treason' to seize fae trade routes, and hides it rather than report it.

chapters.title: The Hollow Court
chapters.summary: Sheltering in an abandoned fae waystation, Ines experiences visions of the last royal taster — her grandmother — betraying the covenant under coercion. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: shame inherited — she realizes her family's exile began here, and that the queen's hunt repeats an old wound.

chapters.title: Crossing at Greywater
chapters.summary: Ambushed at a river ford, Tam is captured while Ines escapes with the map. POV: alternating Ines and Tam. Emotional beat: guilt and resolve — Ines must decide whether rescue or the borderstone comes first, and chooses both, splitting her already thin odds.

chapters.title: The Queen's Table
chapters.summary: Ines infiltrates the palace kitchens one last time to steal proof of the queen's forgery, nearly caught by Vane — who lets her go. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: dangerous hope — Vane's silence is a debt she can't repay, and the stolen decree confirms the hunt was never about safety.

chapters.title: Solstice of the Broken Stone
chapters.summary: At the eclipsed borderstone, Ines frees Tam, confronts the queen's envoy, and offers her own oath to reforge the covenant. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: climax — the stone demands a warden's whole truth; Ines speaks her name, her gift, and her grandmother's crime aloud, and the sigil turns instead of consuming her.

chapters.title: A Seat at No One's Table
chapters.summary: The covenant holds; gifted folk are safe, the queen's forgery exposed, and Vane testifies at cost to himself. Ines, changed by the oath, becomes warden of the pass rather than returning to court. POV: Ines. Emotional beat: belonging found not in a place but in a purpose — she sets a new table where both realms may eat.
